evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Joanna covers: property type (two-bedroom apartment), floor/stories (first to second, elevator available), rooms (master bedroom, second bedroom, living room, dining room), walking distance (one school bus length from pickup; short hallway at delivery), special considerations (83-year-old brother needing help; items limited in second bedroom; elevator uncertainty; potential stair use; items over 300 lbs checked).

Later gives $1,635 for packing on Saturday, distinguishing from Sunday rate.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna covers: hourly rate ($115 per hour per mover, $230 per hour for two movers on Saturday), transportation fee ($75), minimum (2.5 hours), incremental billing (15-minute intervals after minimum), and what's included (assembly, tax, insurance, credit card fees, stair use, $2,000 coverage, on-time guarantee, Meet Your Mover). evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Joanna: 'lastly on time guarantee if we run late, we provide discounts for your move.' Covers the discount framing (immediately applicable if late).
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Joanna: 'we also include up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages.' Mentions amount and inclusion but does not explicitly state 'no deductible' or 'no fine print' framing, nor reiterates it's built into the rate (though she did say 'all of that is already in the price' earlier in the pricing frame).

evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Joanna: 'Alright, okay, thank you so much anything else?' — a throwaway 'anything else?' without a genuine version like 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' appears in the transcript.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. top_strength: Joanna gathered all essential logistics details (property type, floors, room count, walking distances, weight limits, special circumstances) systematically and thoroughly, and delivered a full, personalized estimate with clear pricing transparency and both Two Promises covered.
coaching_note: Never ask for the business—the call ends without an explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?' ask, and no booking is confirmed; add the genuine final concerns check ('What's still concerning you?'), hold silence after 'Does that feel fair?', and always confirm date, phone, arrival window, crew size, and addresses before ending the call.
